name: AI in Design Report 2026
note: The wide masthead yields to offset reading columns and then large, labeled charts. A persistent identity survives a substantial change in information density.
motion: Observed scroll transitions, navigation into the Tools chapter and chapter-level statistical graphics. The moving image band is subordinate to the report.
transfer: Use a finding or report preview at brand scale, then make it genuinely readable.
limit: Opening and Tools chapter inspected; not every chapter or case study.

name: Hamilton
note: The same data marks carry identity and evidence. Narrative occupies one side while the selected relationship remains visible in the visualization.
motion: Observed marks reorganize after scrolling and unrelated song evidence dim around the current narrative. This takes time to settle.
transfer: Keep the source identifiers stable when a finding is selected; change emphasis instead of losing context.
limit: Scroll sequence inspected; exhaustive theme filtering and audio playback not tested. The site asks for a wide desktop viewport.

name: Micro
note: A strongly framed opening gives way to a dark central surface, while material and typography keep continuity. The creator case study connects brand work and interface treatment.
motion: Observed the framed landscape expand and the dark central shape emerge during scrolling. The captured pair records different scroll states.
transfer: Allow a report or evidence surface to change scale into the working product.
limit: Opening and first scroll transition inspected. No logged-in Micro interface was accessed.

name: Obys Experiment Space
note: Oversized type creates a stable anchor for moving work. The About page retains the masthead but replaces the spatial archive with a more useful index and explanatory composition.
motion: Observed the depth-oriented moving archive and the transition to About. The index remains a usable alternative to the exhibition view.
transfer: Give the landing one orchestrated reveal; let the application use a quieter information structure.
limit: Space and About inspected. The 3D gallery itself is not proposed for the DataTrust application.

name: LPAS
note: Adjacent visual panels, generous left alignment and a persistent composition keep the subject in view. The content and navigation are organized by the client’s actual work.
motion: Observed the Listen/Plan/Analyze/Shape introduction widen into the homepage, plus menu opening. The first Explore click landed during the intro; later market scrolling was not verified.
transfer: Keep two source populations visible together and move the framing around them.
limit: Intro, home and menu inspected; market subpages not inspected.

name: Hyperbolic
note: The creator’s case study ties the identity to a specific business argument and shows the system at different scales, from typography and physical renderings to navigation.
motion: Case-study media and scrolling inspected. Live Hyperbolic product interactions were not tested.
transfer: Derive a graphic grammar from evidence relationships, rather than adopting hardware imagery.
limit: Creator case study only. No live product or performance claims are inferred.

name: Cash App Brand Guidelines
note: Small interface primitives sit beside expressive brand objects. The product’s visual vocabulary is recognizable without relying on one background or screen layout.
motion: Observed the animated overview. The Graphic UI click did not produce a confirmed route change; this capture is the overview, not a verified detail page.
transfer: Give DataTrust evidence states and source highlights a coherent visual grammar.
limit: Overview visually inspected; no Cash App account or transaction flow was opened.

name: ART+TECH Report 2023
note: The vivid opening changes into a restrained reading surface. Statistical graphics keep the rounded form vocabulary while titles, explanation and legend remain distinct.
motion: Observed the transition from blue opening composition to white statistical sections through scrolling.
transfer: Carry the identity into analytical visuals without sacrificing legends or denominators.
limit: Opening and one statistical section inspected, not the complete report.

name: Phantom Studios
note: The work overview is dense and panoramic, with small metadata and clear controls. A huge amount of subject matter remains visible at once.
motion: Observed the introductory title sequence settle into the project overview.
transfer: An overview may be visually rich, but DataTrust should always provide a bounded path into a selected finding.
limit: Opening and overview inspected. Pointer behavior and individual project pages were not evaluated.

name: Siena Film Foundation
note: The entry mark resolves into a large, carefully framed subject, with persistent navigation and strongly differentiated metadata.
motion: Observed Enter transition and the film overview. The captured pair shows entry and post-entry states.
transfer: Make the analytical report the framed subject. The ticket shapes, film texture and cinema metaphor do not transfer.
limit: Entry and overview inspected; film detail pages not inspected.

name: Linear
note: A large product preview has legible navigation, selected item context and a clear detail region. The product composition itself does much of the explanation.
motion: Opening and subsequent page content inspected; no authenticated workspace was accessed.
transfer: Preserve selection context and practical density when a marketing preview becomes an application screen.
limit: Secondary application-craft reference, not a proposed brand template.
